notes: Merit study aid up to 50% tuition is published, but Uzbek eligibility not explicit. OAS and local full awards have geographic restrictions.

name: Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina
notes: University describes assistance programmes involving foreign students and PEC-G admissions. Applicants must fund living costs; Uzbek country eligibility unconfirmed.

name: Universita' degli Studi di Ferrara
notes: International entrants may seek ER.GO grants and fee reductions using foreign-income evidence. No-tax area leaves stamp/regional tax; annual award varies.

name: Universitat Internacional de Catalunya
notes: International Excellence covers 20% tuition across years, excluding medicine/dentistry. Pre-University Competition can cover 100% first-year tuition.

name: Universität Rostock
notes: Only semester contributions, no regular tuition. Limited DAAD completion grants assist international bachelor/master students facing financial challenges.

name: Université Paris-Est Créteil Val de Marne
notes: Non-EU licence fee is EUR 2,902/year before living/CVEC. Government-scholar and other statutory exemptions exist; ordinary Uzbek applicant award unconfirmed.
